description: This file contains unit tests for the NixModeStableSuite, specifically testing the resolution logic for nixMode in different app bundle contexts. It defines a test suite with two test cases that manipulate UserDefaults, verify behavior when resolving nixMode, and makes use of test annotations and utility functions.

classes.name: NixModeStableSuiteTests
classes.description: A test suite struct annotated with @Suite(.serialized) that contains two test functions to verify nixMode resolution based on the presence of app bundle context and user defaults configuration.

methods.name: resolves from stable suite for app bundles
methods.description: Tests that nixMode value is correctly resolved when running inside an app bundle with a stable suite, ensuring that the stored value is used during resolution.

methods.name: ignores stable suite outside app bundles
methods.description: Tests that nixMode resolution is bypassed or behaves differently when not running within an app bundle, confirming that the resolveNixMode function acts accordingly.
